_comment: Stateless NACL for the public subnet (10.20.4.0/24), where the load balancer lives. Rules are evaluated lowest number first; first match wins; no match = deny. Inbound rules match the packet SOURCE, outbound rules match the DESTINATION; port_from/port_to are the destination port range. app subnet = 10.20.0.0/22, management subnet = 10.20.5.128/27, ephemeral client ports = 1024-65535.
